definition.name: Original and separately bounded fixed combined graph proofs

steps.name: Verify the unchanged normal profile and fixed combined graph
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-preview-proof"
cargo test --locked -p latent-component-threading --lib rust_component::tests:: -- --nocapture 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-preview-proof/normal.log"
grep -F 'test rust_component::tests::rust_normal_component_recomputes_original_graph_and_rejects_envelope_or_main_changes ... ok' "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-preview-proof/normal.log"
grep -F 'test rust_component::tests::rust_normal_preimage_never_authorizes_forged_or_duplicate_original_material ... ok' "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-preview-proof/normal.log"
cargo test --locked -p latent-component-threading --lib --features rust-http-combined-preview-diagnostic rust_component::tests:: -- --nocapture 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-preview-proof/combined.log"
grep -F 'test rust_component::tests::rust_combined_graph_recomputes_original_without_enabling_a_runtime ... ok' "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-preview-proof/combined.log"

steps.name: Retain bounded proof output including failures

reviewReason: Run the existing normal source proofs and an explicitly selected fixed combined-graph diagnostic; no runtime admission or signed qualification.
